title: Recovery board has no booking source for opening a local-anaesthesia recovery stay
expected: The recovery_board id_sources entry for opening a stay should identify an authorized source that can return a Cleaning or Completed operation with no recovery stay yet. An eligible list or a documented handoff from a permitted screen would let staff select the exact booking.
actual: The current bundle names only GET /ot/recovery-board -> booking_id. The GET is documented as patients in recovery now. The POST is explicitly for an operation without a recovery stay after local anaesthesia and returns OT_RECOVERY_OPEN if the stay already exists. The listed source therefore does not supply the booking for the action that starts a new stay.
steps: Read recovery_board id_sources and both endpoint descriptions. As demo.otnurse, call GET /ot/recovery-board and inspect its patients-in-recovery result. No write or guessed booking ID is needed to reproduce the catalogue mismatch.
evidence: DEV build 2026-11-09T17:10:47.430848+00:00. GET /ot/recovery-board returned 200 and an empty patients list for demo.otnurse, request_id 6e736e7364f9463e8fec3e66f6afb782. This confirms the read works for the role; the documented already-in-recovery scope and the POST's eligibility differ. There was no eligible synthetic operation in this read and no claim that either API handler is broken.
